scope: Human-readable visual inspection of the three supplied fresh live installer screenshots using local image viewing, with artifact hashes verified against the hosted installer evidence.

screenshots.label: english
screenshots.observations: Brand/header and language controls align. Full iPhone/iPad and Android instructions are readable; action labels, intact logo and complete QR are clear. Cards, download links and storage-preservation guidance do not overlap.

screenshots.label: chinese
screenshots.observations: Chinese headings, instructions, account guidance, download labels and preservation note render legibly with proper wrapping. Brand, language controls, QR and buttons fit the page width.

screenshots.label: offline
screenshots.observations: The full installer remains visually complete, including logo, instructions, QR, copy/download controls and preservation guidance. It is byte-identical to the English screenshot.

summary: No visible page overflow, missing images, overlapping controls or unreadable instructional text in either language.
The long installation URL remains contained in its single-line field, with a separate Copy link action below it; the automated evidence binds its complete value.
English online and cold-offline screenshots are identical.
limitations: Screenshots are Chromium captures at 390px width, not physical iOS/Android installation or camera-based QR verification.
No native installation, recipient sharing, authenticated workflow or PDF page visual review was performed in this review.
The screenshot review does not establish a new service-worker update transition.
